purpose: Compare pressure and ordinary performance with context-matched peer averages, then compare the player's relative standing in pressure contexts with their own ordinary standing.

method.league_average: Opportunity-weighted pooled rate across all players in the selected peer cohort, including the subject player.
method.peer_comparator: Opportunity-weighted pooled rate among other players (leave-one-player-out); this is used for relative-performance calculations to avoid self-benchmarking.
method.innings_phase: Powerplay is first 30% of allocated overs; death is final 25%; remaining overs are middle. Standard 20-over phases are 1-6, 7-15, 16-20.
method.relative_performance: For higher-is-better metrics, (player rate / peer rate - 1) * 100. For lower-is-better metrics, (1 - player rate / peer rate) * 100. Positive means better than peer average.
method.relative_change_vs_ordinary: Pressure relative-performance percentage minus the same player's ordinary relative-performance percentage. This compares league-relative standing, not raw rates across different phases.
method.raw_player_rate_caveat: Player pooled rate and peer weighted rate are descriptive; context-adjusted relative-performance fields should be used for cross-phase interpretation.

batting.interpretation: Recorded source runs per 100 balls faced; not asserted as fully scorecard-verified batter runs.
Source is_four plus is_six flags per 100 balls faced.
Dismissals attributed through dismissed_player_id per 100 balls faced; missing IDs are not guessed.

bowling.interpretation: Bowler-creditable wickets per 100 candidate legal deliveries.
Boundary flags conceded per 100 candidate legal deliveries.
Diagnostic only: source runs field per 100 candidate legal deliveries; not total bowler runs conceded.

bowling_pressure_caveat: Early-collapse bowling rows describe bowling against a batting side under collapse pressure; they are not automatically classified as pressure on the bowler. Death-over performance is the primary available bowling pressure context.

source_limitations.runs: The source runs field is used as recorded and is not assumed to be a complete official batting/scorecard total.
source_limitations.bowling_runs: Source runs field is incomplete as bowler-charged runs because extras are missing; its baseline metric is diagnostic-only.
source_limitations.economy_and_dot_balls: No conventional bowling economy rate or true dot-ball rate is created.
source_limitations.candidate_legal_balls: Excludes wide and Overstep rows; retains the single Penalty-coded record in the primary denominator, matching the existing descriptive bowling module.
